sloka: तौ नूनम् दुर्बलाव् अन्धौ मत् प्रतीक्षौ पिपासितौ ।चिरम् आशा कृताम् तृष्णाम् कष्टाम् सम्धारयिष्यतः ॥२-६३-४३॥
transliteration: tau nūnam durbalāv andhau mat pratīkṣau pipāsitau ।ciram āśā kṛtām tṛṣṇām kaṣṭām samdhārayiṣyataḥ ॥2-63-43॥

translations.english: 'How will the two who are frail, thirsty and blind wait for me for long controlling their thirst with great difficulty with the expectation (that I would fetch them water)?
